light.name: Prabhagaj
light.title: the Dawn-Tusk
light.description: The elephant of first light. Nothing is hidden from him for long, and what he shows you, you have to look at.
light.bonus_text: Wounds close faster: +1 hit point regeneration.

water.name: Jalendra
water.title: the Tide-Trunked
water.description: She keeps the rivers and the rain. The water has already made room for you; that is the only welcome she gives, and the only one she means.

fire.name: Agnavar
fire.title: the Ember-Tusked
fire.description: Keeper of every flame that will not go out. The Keepers of Emberhold do not say his name at the hearth, but they do not need to.

wind.name: Vayuketh
wind.title: He Who Breathes the Plains
wind.description: The grass bends when he exhales. He watches the horizon, and his faithful never stay in one place for long.

dark.name: Timiraj
dark.title: the Unlit
dark.description: The place elephants go at the end. He remembers every one who falls, which is not the comfort it sounds like.
dark.bonus_text: Remembered: dying costs half the experience.
